title: Event Loop Phases, libuv, Microtasks vs Macrotasks
trackerTask: Event loop phases, libuv, microtasks vs macrotasks
definition: Single-threaded non-blocking runtime powered by libuv event loop and priority microtask queues.

keyPoints.title: Event Loop Phases
keyPoints.description: 6 distinct phases (timers, pending, poll, check, close) executing callbacks in order.

keyPoints.title: Microtasks First
keyPoints.description: process.nextTick and Promise drain immediately before the next macrotask runs.

keyPoints.title: libuv Offload
keyPoints.description: Delegates OS async (network I/O) and thread pool (crypto, fs) off the single JS thread.

recap: Node.js ka event loop single thread par non-blocking I/O chalata hai libuv ke 6 phases (timers, pending, poll, check, close) ke zariye. Microtasks (process.nextTick aur Promises) har macrotask aur phase transition ke beech turant drain hote hain.

demos.title: Event Loop Phase Runner
demos.summary: Interactive event loop execution order puzzle visualizer.
